newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 10.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Thursday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:
-- General Motors Corp to place all diesel engine production with Isuzu Motors Ltd.
-- Fair Trade Commission issues guideline on holding companies.
-- Osaka takes edge as candidate city for 2008 Olympic Summer Games.
-- Health and Welfare Ministry panel to debate brain death issue.
-- Finance Ministry to suspend Nomura Securities Co Ltd from dealing in stocks for its own account.
-- Debate on ways to streamline government administration under way.
